chapter: Opening and who he played with
title: Fred Washington and the musicians Bourgeau played with
summary: Asked about pianist Fred Washington, then lists men he played with: Chris Kelly, Walter Pichon, Kid Howard and Kid Thomas.

blocks.x: Did you know Fred Washington? Fred Washington?
Fred Washington? Good. Yeah. I know him pretty good.

Yeah. Now you want to know the fellas that I played with? Yeah. Well, I played with Chris Kelly. Played banjo. Who else was in Chris Kelly's band? Who else was in Chris Kelly's band? Who else was in Chris Kelly's band? Well, I don't know the boys. How many pieces do you have? We had five pieces. Five pieces. Five pieces.
